content.bridge_context: Understanding how agriculture has evolved in India and its importance.

units.title: What is Farming?
units.explanation: Growing crops and rearing animals for food and other products.
units.dual_language_instruction: List three crops grown in your area. / अपने क्षेत्र में उगाई जाने वाली तीन फसलों की सूची बनाएं।

units.title: Traditional vs Modern Farming
units.explanation: Traditional uses manual labor and animals. Modern uses machines, fertilizers, and irrigation.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify a tractor in a picture. / चित्र में ट्रैक्टर की पहचान करें।
